name: Call recording, transcription, and semantic search platform

mentions.name: Call recording, transcription, and semantic search platform
mentions.description: Call recording and voice intelligence platform that records phone calls, transcribes them, generates AI summaries, and enables semantic search over transcripts, at $0.30/hour as a cheaper alternative to Twilio Voice Intelligence ($1.50/hour). Supports cross-lingual semantic search, where a Spanish query returns English calls without any translation code. Built on 15+ Go microservices running on k3s.
mentions.problem: Twilio Voice Intelligence is expensive at $1.50/hour; this offers comparable call recording, transcription, and AI summary capabilities at $0.30/hour.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a cheaper alternative to Twilio Voice Intelligence. Record phone calls, transcribe, generate AI summaries, enable semantic search over transcripts — $0.30/hour vs Twilio's $1.50/hour.
